title: OpenDesign 0.27.1 — Invite Friends, Earn Reset
body:
Get up to 6 RESET on OpenDesign 🎉
Invite a friend to subscribe. Both earn a Reset Card.
First month $8. Up to $220 in DeepSeek usage.
Motion videos, design & slides, all in OpenDesign.
